_documentation.purpose: Exception list for the dead code scanner. Use this to exclude specific files or exports from dead code detection.
_documentation.WARNING: ⚠️ EXCEPTIONS SHOULD BE USED SPARINGLY! The default action when a commit is blocked should be to INVESTIGATE and REMOVE the dead code. Only add exceptions when you have confirmed that the code IS being used but cannot be detected by static analysis (e.g., dynamic imports, external API contracts, test utilities).

fields.files: Array of file paths (relative to project root) to exclude entirely from scanning
fields.exports: Array of specific exports to exclude, format: 'path/to/file.ts:exportName'
fields.patterns: Array of regex patterns to match against file paths or export names

_documentation.review_process: Before adding an exception, ask: 1) Is this code actually used? 2) Can the scanner be improved to detect its usage? 3) Is there a better way to structure the code? Only proceed if all answers point to a legitimate exception.

_exports_justification.src/App.tsx:default: Main App component used in main.tsx - ts-prune doesn't detect dynamic/entry imports
